caller_is_validator.meaning: the caller of batchTransfers/rBatchTransfers holds the validator role

recipient_kyc_verified.meaning: the recipient (creditor) address is marked isKycVerified

validator_exercises_batch.meaning: a compromised or malicious validator exercises the privileged batch functions

batch_moves_funds.meaning: a batch settlement call moves balances from a KYC-verified debtor to a non-KYC/sanctioned creditor

kyc_gate_enforced.meaning: the executed balance-movement path enforces the isKycVerified recipient gate (on-chain KYC guarantee holds for downstream integrators)

claims.scope: validator-only batch settlement (batchTransfers/rBatchTransfers) mutating balances without KYC or pause checks

preconditions.text: batchTransfers and rBatchTransfers are restricted to the validator role.; Standard transfer, transferFrom, mint and burn revert when the recipient (and for mint/burn the holder) is not marked isKycVerified.; The scenario assumes a compromised or malicious validator exercising the privileged batch functions.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: All token balance movements, including validator batch settlement, must be KYC-gated so funds cannot reach non-KYC recipients.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: On-chain KYC guarantees become unreliable, exposing downstream integrators that rely on transfer gating.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The validator is treated as compromised or malicious, exercising the privileged batch functions.
The batch call moves funds from a KYC-verified debtor to a non-KYC or sanctioned creditor.
Standard transfer/transferFrom/mint/burn paths are KYC-gated; only the batch paths are at issue here.

limitations: Formalizes only the regulatory_risk impact (unreliable on-chain KYC guarantee for downstream integrators); the pause-bypass impact is handled in a separate pass.
The KYC gate is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report states the isKycVerified condition qualitatively without a numeric definition.
The condition is narrowed to the validator batch-settlement scenario the report establishes, not a general all-callers scope.
